rule: The current Thread Map is the opening post's Map, replaced by the newest kind: snapshot post that carries one. Newest is code-unit filename order. A snapshot without a Map, an empty map: key and every other kind never replace it. A Map that fails to parse is skipped and named; a Map with dropped members still counts. A lookback cap or a partial read that stops before a snapshot falls back to the opening post's Map and reports stopped. Only canonical direct post files are read.
expected_fields: status, post (id and path) or absent, members (positions of the chosen Map, in order), reason when status is none, skipped, warnings (field and warning of the chosen post's Map), lookback
